title: Malta Story
creator: Brian Desmond Hurst
description: Alec Guinness plays an RAF reconnaissance pilot stranded on Malta during the siege of 1942. It was filmed on the island, with real wartime footage of bombing raids and the arrival of the convoys.

title: Midnight Express
creator: Alan Parker
description: The story of an American student imprisoned in Turkey for drug smuggling. Malta stood in for Istanbul, and Fort St. Elmo played the prison.

title: Popeye
creator: Robert Altman
description: Robin Williams as the sailor man, in Robert Altman’s odd live-action musical. The ramshackle village of Sweethaven was built in a cove on Malta’s northwest coast and still stands as a theme park.

title: Gladiator
creator: Ridley Scott
description: Russell Crowe as a Roman general turned gladiator. The Roman Colosseum and the streets of ancient Rome were built as sets inside Fort Ricasoli, across the harbor mouth from Valletta.

title: Munich
creator: Steven Spielberg
description: Spielberg’s film about the Israeli agents who hunted the men behind the 1972 Munich Olympics massacre. Valletta and Malta stood in for Rome, Athens, Beirut, and other cities.
